meta.title: Kivo — Hosting for websites and databases in Mexico, with invoicing
meta.description: Host your sites, apps, and PostgreSQL databases with automatic deploys from GitHub, daily backups, billing in pesos, and CFDI invoicing.

hero.title: Host your sites and databases without fighting servers
hero.subtitle: Push to GitHub and your project publishes itself. Databases with daily backups, SSL included, billing in pesos, and CFDI invoicing.

hostingTypes.heading: Host whatever you're building
hostingTypes.subtitle: From a static site to a full stack with a database: you pick what you need.

sites.title: Websites
sites.text: Landing pages, portfolios, and static sites (HTML, Astro, Next.js).

apps.title: Applications
apps.text: Next.js, Node, Bun, Laravel, Python, or any project with a Dockerfile.

database.title: Databases
database.text: Managed PostgreSQL, with SSL, resource limits, and daily backups.

fullstack.title: Full projects
fullstack.text: Docker Compose with API, frontend, and database together, on a private network.

howItWorks.heading: From your repository to production in 3 steps
howItWorks.note: Is your domain on Cloudflare? We can publish your project with Cloudflare Tunnel, without opening any ports.

connect.title: Connect your GitHub repository
connect.text: Or send us your Docker Compose.

configure.title: We set everything up
configure.text: Domain, SSL, database, variables, and backups.

push.title: Push and you're done
push.text: Every change on your main branch publishes automatically.

pricingDev.heading: Clear pricing for developers
pricingDev.text: Prices in MXN, plus tax. CFDI 4.0 invoicing included.

security.heading: Security and backups, without the hype

backups.title: Automatic daily backups
backups.text: Of your databases, with 7 days of history.

ssl.title: SSL everywhere
ssl.text: On your sites and on the database connection.

privateDb.title: Private databases
privateDb.text: Never exposed to the internet, only your app can see them.

monitoring.title: 24/7 monitoring
monitoring.text: With immediate alerts if something fails.

resellers.heading: Developer or agency? Earn from your clients
resellers.highlight: You charge your clients the hosting fee, we take care of the servers.
resellers.cta: I want to become a reseller

referral.title: Referrals
referral.text: Refer us and earn 20% of what your referral pays for 12 months. Open to anyone.

reseller.title: Reseller
reseller.text: Buy at wholesale price (30% off), charge your clients whatever you want, and put your own brand on it. We manage the servers, the backups, and invoice you.

launchOffer.title: Founding clients: the first 10 developers get their first month free and 30% off for life.

invoice.question: Do you provide invoices?
invoice.answer: Yes, we issue CFDI 4.0 invoices for every payment.

requirements.question: What do I need to host my project?
requirements.answer: A GitHub repository or a Dockerfile / Docker Compose. We test your project before activating it to confirm it works.

location.question: Where are the servers?
location.answer: In Mexico, on our own infrastructure, managed directly by us.

incidents.question: What happens if something fails?
incidents.answer: We have 24/7 monitoring with alerts. If your site or database has an issue, we'll let you know and fix it as soon as possible.

restore.question: Can I restore a backup?
restore.answer: Yes, we keep 7 days of daily backups. Ask for it on Discord or WhatsApp.

migration.question: Can I migrate my project from another provider?
migration.answer: Yes, migration from Vercel, Railway, or cPanel is free.

payment.question: How do I pay?
payment.answer: SPEI transfer or card. Monthly or annual billing (with 2 months free).

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes, no forced terms. We'll hand over your files and a backup of your database.

webDesign.heading: No website yet? We design those too
webDesign.text: Web design is a separate service from hosting: if you need us to build your site from scratch, we do that too.
